title: StateFuse: Deterministic Conflict-Preserving Memory for Multi-Agent Systems
readingScope: 完整读了 arXiv v1 的 §§1–6、Appendix A.1–A.5、Tables 1–5 与 Figures 1–3，共 18 个 PDF pages；references 只用于 lineage 定位。另检查 official source commit 79a6229f83a7b174a2a9ac8fd0ace267ae30e79b（StateFuse 0.3.0），运行完整 139-test official suite，并执行 preregistered model-free interpretation-contract audit：8 个 synthetic fixtures、17 个 same-contract permutation groups、428 个 raw state/projection rows 与一次 fresh byte reproduction。没有复现论文的 MemoryAgentBench slice、uniform-verification agent loop、correction-handle ablation、模型输出、live connector 或 production trace；repository 中标题不同的 unpublished manuscript 只作为独立 successor source 标注，不向 arXiv v1 反向转移主张。
intro: StateFuse 把 replicated memory 拆成两个容易被混淆的层：immutable OpSet 负责让 operation set 收敛，predicate registry、conflict detector、resolver 与 query constraints 再把这个集合解释成可行动的 view。
whyRead: 这篇值得做成 worked essay，不是因为它发明了新的 CRDT join——作者反复否认这一点——而是因为它把 agent memory 最常被悄悄吞掉的三件事变成 public contract：分歧是否被显式保留、修正到底指向一个 assertion 还是一个 semantic class、downstream resolver 能否把选择写回历史。close read 与本地测试合在一起后，真正有用的结论更尖锐：merge substrate 的确定性只管同一组 immutable operations；要让 replica 的 semantic view 也可复现，还必须绑定 interpretation contract。
keyPoints: Contract boundary：StateFuse 以 immutable EvidenceAdded / ClaimAdded / ClaimRetracted / DecisionAdded operations 构成 OpSet；materialization 先计算 effective claim refs、应用 exact / semantic tombstones、过滤 inactive claims，再为 functional keys 生成显式 ConflictSet。projection 可以选择、abstain 或 fail closed，但不能修改 base memory。（§§3.2–3.4；Figure 1，PDF pp. 5–7）

Dual correction handles：arXiv v1 将 claim_id 定义为 assertion-local identity，将 claim_ref 定义为由 claim key 与 predicate-governed value contract 导出的 cross-replica semantic handle。（arXiv v1 §§3.2–3.3；Appendix A.1、A.3–A.4）

Paper result：在 282-question MemoryAgentBench conflict-bearing slice 上，aggressive StateFuse、flat multi-value、raw log 与 collapsed baselines 同为 97.5% final accuracy；显式 conflict-preserving surfaces 的差异主要是 100% conflict recall。uniform-verification synthetic loop 中 conservative non-collapsing surfaces 同到 100% post-verify success，而 collapsed surface 为 60% 且有 40% post-verify false confidence。（§4.2；Tables 2–4，PDF pp. 9–11）

argumentMap.step: 01 · 先把 merge 与 interpretation 拆开
argumentMap.claim: 论文接受标准 OpSet set-union 作为 convergence substrate；它的研究对象不是新的 join，而是 operations 收敛之后，memory 怎样形成 active claims、conflicts 与 task-scoped projection。

argumentMap.step: 02 · 把 disagreement 留在 public surface
argumentMap.claim: materialization 不以 latest-write 覆盖 functional-key disagreement，而是发出 ConflictSet；resolver 的 authority 被限制在 projection，resolution 失败或 abstention 仍留下 unresolved/surfaced conflict 与 explanation。

argumentMap.step: 03 · 用 matched policy budget 收窄 empirical claim
argumentMap.claim: strong flat conflict-preserving baselines 在 answer accuracy 与 conservative operating point 上能追平 StateFuse；因此论文把贡献收窄为 contradiction surfacing、abstention 与 auditable semantic correction 的 contract，而不是 universal accuracy gain。

methodNotes.label: OpSet materialization and projection
methodNotes.text: Merge 对 immutable op_id 做 set union；materialization 以 sorted traversal 建索引、派生 refs、应用 exact/semantic tombstones、按 ClaimKey 分组并生成 conflicts。build_view 读取 materialized state 与 constraints，由 deterministic conservative resolver 或受 schema 限制的 optional LLM resolver 形成 separate projection。

methodNotes.label: Paper evaluation layers
methodNotes.text: 主 evidence 是 converted official MemoryAgentBench conflict-bearing slice 与每种 surface 共享 verification budget 的 50-task synthetic agent loop；另用 13-task deterministic handle ablation 比较 claim_id / claim_ref。paper tables 报 final accuracy、false certainty、conflict recall、recoverability 与 abstention quality，但本次本站 audit 没有重跑这些 datasets/runs。

reportedFindings: aggressive official-slice comparison中，StateFuse、flat multi-value、raw log 与 collapsed latest-write 都是 97.5% final accuracy；StateFuse 与 flat conflict-preserving surfaces 为 100% conflict recall，raw log/collapsed 为 0%。这支持 surface distinction，不支持 unique answer-accuracy gain。（§4.2；Table 3，PDF pp. 9、11）

conservative official-slice operating point 中，StateFuse、StateFuse core、MV register 与 provenance surface 都为 64.9% accuracy、100% conflict recall、2.1% false certainty；raw log conservative 同为 64.9% accuracy 但 0% conflict recall。（Tables 2–3，PDF pp. 10–11）

uniform-verification 50-task loop 中，五个 conservative non-collapsing surfaces 都从 80% pre-verify 到 100% post-verify success、0% post-verify false confidence；collapsed surface 从 40% 到 60%，仍有 40% false confidence。该 loop deterministic，paper 因此没有给 confidence intervals。（Tables 2、4，PDF pp. 10–11）

13-task correction-handle ablation 中，claim_ref 为 100% final accuracy / no-resurrection / ID-target match / semantic-target recoverability；claim_id 为 76.9% / 76.9% / 100% / 0%。这是 paper 对 semantic handle expressivity 的主要支持。（§4.3；Table 5，PDF pp. 9–10、12）
evidenceLimits: 论文的 strongest external evidence 是一个 converted MemoryAgentBench conflict-bearing slice；本站没有取得并独立重算这 282 questions 的转换、predictions 或 aggregate，也没有重跑 50-task agent loop 与 13-task handle ablation，因此这些数字保持 paper-reported。

uniform-verification loop 与 handle ablation 是 controlled deterministic evaluations，没有 repeated stochastic runs 或 confidence intervals；论文也没有 large naturally arising trace study、broad benchmark portfolio 或 endpoint-specific live LLM comparison。（§5.5，PDF pp. 12–13）
H1 只证明 exact StateFuse 0.3.0 在四组 newly authored synthetic fixture strata 上允许 cross-contract semantic divergence；它不估计 replica contract drift 的生产频率、损害、攻击可利用性、整体 reliability 或对其他 versions 的适用性。

H2 组合的是 source 已明确的 broad semantic tombstone 与 validity-independent default ref identity。它证明 recurrence consequence，不证明 library bug、data loss 或错误 ontology；需要 occurrence-local correction 的应用可以把 occurrence 编入 key/value/context，或使用 exact-ID handle。

同一 fixed contract 下的 17 个 permutation groups 全部产生单一 state/projection digest；因此当前结果不能被写成 merge-order nondeterminism、OpSet commutativity/associativity/idempotence failure 或论文 Propositions 1–2 的 same-contract counterexample。

repository 的 paper/main.tex 在 locked commit 中是标题和实验叙述均不同的 unpublished successor manuscript。official suite 的 139 passed/0 skipped 是本地 source execution receipt，不能反向替代 arXiv v1 的 paper-reported evidence或被说成 paper reproduction。

sourceTensions.label: Same OpSet 不是完整 replay identity
sourceTensions.observation: Appendix Proposition 1 将 benign-replica convergence 写成 O1 = O2 ⇒ M(O1) = M(O2)，但 Proposition 6 的 projection replayability 明确还要求 fixed predicate registry、resolver 与 constraints；official source 接受 pluggable equality/ref normalization 与 conflict detectors，却没有把一份 shared contract digest 绑定进 OpSet。
sourceTensions.implication: 对外引用 convergence 时必须补全 interpretation precondition。可复现 semantic view 的 identity 是 operations 加 contract/query/projection inputs，而不是 operation bytes 单独决定。
locators: official source 79a6229… predicate registry / detector paths

sourceTensions.label: Semantic correction 的优势与范围来自同一机制
sourceTensions.observation: Paper-reported：arXiv v1 在 contract 层将 claim_ref 描述为由 claim key 与 predicate-governed value contract 导出的 semantic handle，并规定 semantic-handle retraction 的 no-resurrection 语义。Official-source observation：锁定的 0.3.0 default implementation 具体将 key/value、non-default kind 与 non-empty context 纳入 ref payload，同时将 validity 与其他 occurrence metadata 留在 payload 之外。H2 因此属于 exact-source synthetic audit 的 correction-scope observation，不是 arXiv v1 报告的实验结果。
sourceTensions.implication: missing-ID recoverability 与 cross-occurrence tombstone carryover 不能被当作无关特性：handle 的 semantic identity 越宽，correction reach 越强，应用越需要明确 recurrence / occurrence ontology。这只识别一个 locked implementation 与 fixture family 产生的 correction granularity，不证明 paper contradiction、defect、vulnerability 或普遍更优的 occurrence ontology。

sourceTensions.label: arXiv v1 与 repository manuscript 必须分层
sourceTensions.observation: reviewed arXiv v1 题为 StateFuse: Deterministic Conflict-Preserving Memory for Multi-Agent Systems；locked repository 的 paper/main.tex 是题为 StateFuse: Taxonomy-Aware Conflict-Preserving Memory for Heterogeneous Agent Systems 的 unpublished successor manuscript。两者共享 project lineage，但不是同一个 reviewed evidence object，其主张或 test counts 不向 arXiv v1 反向转移。
sourceTensions.implication: essay 只把 PDF pp. locators 归给 arXiv v1；current source/manuscript 用 exact commit 与 unpublished-successor 标签单列，不能用后来的 code/tests/manuscript 修补 paper claim。

editorialInferences.label: Merge convergence is not view convergence
editorialInferences.text: replicated memory 的一致性至少有两个 axes：operation membership 是否收敛，以及相同 operations 是否在相同 semantic contract 下得到同一 active/conflict/projection view。只给 OpSet hash 只能回答第一问。
editorialInferences.boundary: 这是对 paper replay preconditions 与 H1 synthetic result 的 architecture synthesis；不是新 CRDT theorem、形式证明或对 StateFuse merge implementation 的 failure claim。

editorialInferences.label: Interpretation contracts need deployable identity
editorialInferences.text: normalizer、equality、claim-ref derivation、detector behavior 与 detector ID 应形成可比较的 manifest/version，并在 replica handshake、snapshot、migration 与 audit receipt 中共同出现；deterministic source code 仍可能是另一份 deterministic contract。
editorialInferences.boundary: audit 证明 current exact source 不强制 cross-replica contract identity；它没有验证某一种 manifest protocol、rolling upgrade mechanism 或 distributed deployment。

editorialInferences.label: Correction handles are ontology, not only API ergonomics
editorialInferences.text: claim_id、claim_ref 与 occurrence-bearing identity 分别回答“撤回这次 assertion”“撤回这类 semantic assertion”“撤回这个时段/事件实例”。把它们 collapse 成一个 retraction endpoint，会让 correction authority 的范围只能靠 payload accident 决定。
editorialInferences.boundary: H2 展示 current default identity 的 controlled consequence；不同 domain 可以合理选择不同 granularity，本站没有宣布 universal correct ontology。

editorialInferences.label: Surfacing conflict and authorizing action are separate
editorialInferences.text: ConflictSet 让 disagreement 变得可见，但不会替 agent 决定何时 abstain、验证、选择或请求 human review。一个 auditable memory surface 是 action governance 的输入，不是 authorization 本身。
editorialInferences.boundary: paper 的 bounded resolver contract 与 synthetic loop 支持分层阅读；它没有测 human oversight、real-world action cost 或 high-stakes deployment safety。

openProtocols.title: Replica contract-manifest and rolling-migration protocol
openProtocols.question: 当 replicas 在 registry、claim-ref derivation 或 detector version 上滚动升级时，什么 manifest/handshake contract 能让 semantic-view divergence 被拒绝、显式隔离或可审计迁移，而不重写 immutable history？
openProtocols.method: 在 fixed OpSets 上引入 canonical contract manifest，分别执行 same-version replay、silent behavior drift、declared-version change、mixed-version rolling window 与 explicit migration projection；每次 merge/materialize 前比较 manifest identity，并把 reject/quarantine/dual-view/migrate 四种 policy 写成独立 treatments。
openProtocols.fixtures: 复用 H1 equality、ref-normalization 与 detector/lifecycle OpSets，再增加 old-ref/new-ref 并存、old detector resolution 对 new candidate set 失效、semantic tombstone 跨 identity-version 与 snapshot restore cases。
openProtocols.controls: byte-identical operations、fixed query/resolver/serializer、same-contract positives、manifest-only negative、behavior-different same-ID adversarial control、declared-version control、clean restart 与 two-replica exchange；不使用 model、live connector 或 private trace。
openProtocols.measures: 分别报告 operation-set convergence、manifest agreement、state/projection digest agreement、rejected/quarantined operations、dual-view exposure、resolution carryover、retraction reach 与 migration reversibility；任何 automatic rewrite 都必须保留 old/new provenance。
openProtocols.limitations: 这是 proposed-not-run deployment-contract protocol。它不能从当前 local fixtures 推出 production prevalence、network partition behavior、Byzantine safety、schema-migration policy或最佳 user-facing resolution experience。

contributions.title: Interpretation-contract binding and semantic-reference recurrence audit
contributions.basis: Paper-facing audit of arXiv:2607.05844v1 and official nZiben/statefuse commit 79a6229f83a7b174a2a9ac8fd0ace267ae30e79b (package 0.3.0), with exact source/test blobs, the repository's separately labeled unpublished manuscript, and newly authored synthetic fixtures.
contributions.boundary: This is a preregistered, model-free synthetic interpretation-contract test. It is not a paper benchmark reproduction, model or connector evaluation, CRDT merge-law counterexample, security vulnerability, bug declaration, production frequency/harm estimate, or validation of the repository successor manuscript's experiments.
contributions.method: Lock the paper, source commit, package version, source/test blobs, registry/detector descriptors, resolver, queries and serializers; run the complete official suite; execute all permutations for eight exact fixtures; store 428 schema-versioned state/projection snapshots; recompute every payload digest and derive H1/H2 decisions from raw fields; then repeat the full pass and byte-compare the primary outputs.
contributions.environment: macOS 26.5.2 arm64；CPython 3.13.3；pytest 9.1.1；StateFuse imported from a reader-supplied clean exact checkout；socket network guard around every custom registry/detector invocation；no model, API, credential, benchmark trace, live connector or private data.
contributions.fixture: H1 uses raw/folded equality, raw/folded semantic-handle normalization, detector A/B vs A/B/C under a silent same-ID drift, and a declared detector-v2 control. H2 uses disjoint Monday/Tuesday validity occurrences with none, exact-ID, same-ref, changed-context and changed-value treatments, each queried at Tuesday noon and valid_at=None where applicable.
contributions.controls: Canonical operation JSON and OpSet SHA-256 equality across paired contracts; exact case/group/result matrix; exhaustive 2/6/120 constructor permutations; fixed query, resolver, locale/timezone and serializer; source/paper/blob locks; complete pytest receipts; raw-payload rederivation; same-invocation fresh second pass; checked file-set manifest and clean source checkout.
contributions.rawResult: The official suite collected and passed 139 tests with zero skips. Eight fixtures produced 17 same-contract permutation groups and 428 raw rows; every group had one state digest and one projection digest. H1 equality, ref-normalization, detector/lifecycle and declared-version strata matched their preregistered field-level expectations. H2 same-ref retraction deactivated both disjoint-validity claims; exact-ID and identity-changing controls preserved Tuesday. All eight primary files byte-matched the fresh second pass.
contributions.derivedResult: At the exact 0.3.0 source, byte-identical immutable operations do not alone determine one materialized/projected view across different deterministic interpretation contracts. The tested differences can change conflict formation, effective semantic handles, activity, candidate membership, resolution applicability and projection. Default semantic-ref tombstones also cross validity occurrences that share semantic identity. Every tested fixed-contract constructor-permutation group produced one state digest and one projection digest; merge-tree equivalence and implementation-internal replay-path independence were not tested.
contributions.limitations: The fixtures are deliberately small synthetic contract cases and do not estimate prevalence, harm or performance. The audit does not reproduce paper benchmarks, evaluate models/connectors, exercise distributed networking or concurrency, prove formal properties, label semantic-ref behavior incorrect, or establish that real deployments use mismatched contracts. Same-environment byte reproduction is not cross-platform reproducibility.

pdf.accessNote: 本站不重新分发这份 PDF；请从 arXiv official source 阅读 reviewed v1。

editorialQuestion: 如果 operations 已经 byte-identical，但 replicas 没有共同绑定 predicate registry、claim-ref derivation 与 detector implementation identity，我们究竟是在复制同一份 memory，还是只复制了同一份待解释的历史？
sourceNote: arXiv v1，2026-07-07；PDF 共 18 页，essay locators 使用 printed PDF page numbers。official source audit 锁定 commit 79a6229… / StateFuse 0.3.0。repository paper/main.tex 是标题与实验叙述不同的 unpublished successor manuscript，已与 arXiv v1 分层；139-test receipt 与 428-row synthetic audit 只支持 current-source contract claims。

designTransfer.when: 同一份操作历史要在多个副本上解释，或撤回操作需要区分一次断言与一类语义主张。
designTransfer.move: 同时记录 operation identity 与解释规则的版本；在设计撤回接口时说清它针对 assertion、语义内容还是具体事件实例。
designTransfer.check: 把同一组 operations 交给不同 normalizer / detector 配置，比较 active 与 conflict view；再加入内容相同但时间不同的断言，检查撤回范围。
designTransfer.boundary: 迁移到你的项目的对照未执行。已有 synthetic audit 限于锁定实现与 fixtures，不是 OpSet merge law 的反例，也未验证分布式 rollout。
designTransfer.basis: 既有札记 §§3.2–3.4、Appendix A.1/A.3–A.4；公开测试 H1/H2。

observations: 本条 worked essay 所附的 synthetic contract audit 在锁定的 StateFuse 0.3.0 source 上显示：在这些 preregistered fixtures 中，byte-identical operations 仍可因 deterministic interpretation contracts 不同而产生不同的 conflict、activity、resolution lifecycle 与 projection；这收窄的是 replay precondition，不构成 OpSet merge law 的反例。

锁定的 0.3.0 official source 进一步显示，default ref payload 包含 key 与 value，仅在 non-default 时包含 kind、在 non-empty 时包含 context；validity、confidence、timestamp、evidence、provenance 与 derivation identity 不进入该 payload。semantic retraction 会使共享该 ref 的 claim instances 失活，包括随后才进入 merged OpSet 的 instances。（arXiv v1 §§3.2–3.3；Appendix A.1、A.3–A.4，printed PDF pp. 5–6、14–15；official source src/statefuse/model.py 与 src/statefuse/materialize.py）

Executed synthetic result：锁定 0.3.0 source 上的 8 个 exact fixtures、17 个 fixed-contract constructor-permutation groups 与 428 个 raw state/projection rows 满足 preregistered H1/H2 gates。每个 fixed-contract group 各自产生一个 state digest 与一个 projection digest。该结果未测试 merge-tree equivalence、实现内部 replay-path independence 或跨环境重现。（public synthetic contract test）

reasoning.step: 04 · 再问 fixed OpSet 是否已经足够
reasoning.claim: 论文的 replayability 明示 fixed predicate registry、resolver 与 constraints；本地 audit 进一步显示 current source 没有把 registry/detector implementation identity 写进 shared OpSet。same-contract replay 仍稳定，但 cross-contract replicas 可以对同一 operations 形成不同 semantic views。

reasoning.step: 05 · 把 correction scope 当 ontology 选择
reasoning.claim: semantic ref 是故意设计的 broad correction handle。它能解决 missing-ID / unseen-target correction，也会让不同 validity occurrences 在 semantic identity 相同时共享 tombstone；应用必须明确自己要 correction assertion、occurrence 还是 semantic class。

methods.label: Preregistered interpretation-contract audit
methods.text: H1 的 equality、semantic-handle normalization 与 detector/lifecycle strata 在 paired treatments 中锁定 canonical operation JSON、OpSet hash、query constraints、resolver、serialization、locale/timezone；H2 使用 Monday/Tuesday disjoint validity claims，比较 no retraction、exact-ID、same-ref、changed-context 与 changed-value controls。每个 fixed-contract OpSet 穷举全部 2、6 或 120 个 constructor permutations。

methods.label: Source, suite and reproduction receipts
methods.text: runner 锁定 arXiv PDF hash、official commit、package version、14 个 source/test/manuscript blobs 与自身 source hash；记录 pytest collect/run 全输出，重算 428 rows 的 payload digests 与 H1/H2 decision，再在同一 invocation 内完整执行 second pass，对八个 primary files 做 byte comparison。

findings: 本地 H1 中，byte-identical operations 在不同 deterministic equality/ref/detector contracts 下改变 conflict formation、effective refs、inactive sets、candidate membership、resolution lifecycle 与 projection；declared detector v2 control 把 behavior change 移到新的 visible locus。H2 中 same-ref retraction 同时停用 disjoint-validity Monday/Tuesday claims，而 exact-ID、changed-context 与 changed-value controls 保留 Tuesday claim。（public synthetic contract test）
